{{Top|leg}}
A '''heat projector''' was installed in [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. It caused the exterior of the armor to heat up, burning anyone who touched it. It only worked for a limited time, however. [[Dyyz Nataz]] had a heat projector integrated into his armor.
